name: MM slb 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
G21 ; millimetres
G90 ; absolute XYZ positioning
M82 ; absolute extrusion for the purge path
M107 ; part cooling fan off
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; start heating bed
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; start heating nozzle
G28 ; home using the configured SN04-N Z probe
; G29 ; optional: uncomment only when a fresh mesh is wanted for every print
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ; wait for bed
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ; wait for nozzle
G92 E0
G1 Z5 F600
G1 X5 Y5 F6000
G1 Z0.5 F300
G1 Y50 E8 F1000
G1 X50 E16 F1000
G92 E0
M117 Printing...
machine_end_gcode:
M400 ; finish buffered moves
G92 E0
G1 E-1 F600 ; release nozzle pressure
G91 ; relative XYZ
G1 Z5 F600 ; lift clear of the print
G90 ; absolute XYZ
G1 X0 Y120 F6000 ; park inside the 125 mm bed
M104 S0 ; hotend off
M140 S0 ; bed off
M107 ; part cooling fan off
M84 ; steppers off
